name: SolidCraft
description: Unofficial SolidCraft integration for Unraid, maintained by denara. The CAD application and browser app are developed by bherbruck and the upstream SolidCraft contributors; denara provides the Unraid integration, not the original CAD application. SolidCraft features and upstream changes: https://github.com/bherbruck/solidcraft. Additional features provided by this Unraid integration: - Container packaging and Unraid template with persistent server files and resource/security limits. - Authenticated HTTP MCP gateway for local AI clients, with independent CAD sessions and bounded capacity. - Protected live file and session dashboard at /workspace: server-push updates, virtual project groups, saved model details, PNG thumbnails, original icons, search, filters and downloads; opened files, unsaved changes and new drafts. - Optional remembered browser login for 7 days, 30 days or until logout, independently of MCP authentication; the token is not retained in browser storage. - Shared-file revision checks to reject stale saves and accidental overwrites by parallel clients. - Operational logs for authentication and session allocation/release, with Unraid category colors, icons and the token file location. - Independent hosting of the upstream browser CAD app, with a protected shortcut to open saved models as independent browser copies; browser edits are not automatically written back to server files or MCP sessions. Linux amd64 only. Experimental software: latest contains the newest container build that passed modelling, persistence and web checks. Server designs and exports persist under /data/files. The dashboard uses the existing MCP token; it does not edit models. This is not an official upstream distribution. Unraid® is a registered trademark of Lime Technology, Inc. This application is not affiliated with, endorsed, or sponsored by Lime Technology, Inc.

paths.name: Persistent data
paths.description: Choose your appdata folder, writable by UID 99 / GID 100. Contains mcp-token and files/.

ports.name: Web and MCP port
ports.description: Web at / ; MCP at /mcp. Nginx can proxy both through this port.

variables.name: Allowed origins
variables.description: Replace this example with your hostname. Comma-separated exact browser origins; clients without Origin can authenticate normally.

variables.name: Maximum CAD sessions
variables.description: Each session has its own CAD process and model; 1 to 32.

variables.name: Idle session seconds
variables.description: Unsaved models are discarded on expiry. Explicitly save designs you want to keep.

variables.name: Tool timeout seconds
variables.description: A timed-out CAD process is ended; operations are never automatically retried.
